output.reason: Two weeks postpartum with detachment, constant crying and new frightening thoughts of harming the baby requires immediate emergency psychiatric assessment to distinguish postpartum depression with intrusive thoughts from postpartum psychosis and to ensure infant safety today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now for an urgent mental health assessment, and have someone else care for and stay with the baby until you are seen. New thoughts of harming your baby so soon after birth need same-hour, in-person evaluation. Do not go alone if you can avoid it; if you feel you might act on these thoughts, or you start seeing or hearing things others don't, call 911 immediately.
